olivia_support: Escalation from Acme — their ingestion pipeline is failing on our JSON-mode responses. Getting JSON parse errors in prod. Customer says it started after yesterday's model update. Blocking for a big customer, need triage and comms.

olivia_support: Sample response they pasted:
```json
{"user_id": 123, "result": "ok",}
```
(the trailing comma shows up intermittently; their parser rejects it)

ravi_se: Can you paste the original API request (headers + params) and which model/engine they hit? Also did they use streaming? :eyes:

olivia_support: Request they used (redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.3-large","mode":"json","json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"user_id":{"type":"integer"},"result":{"type":"string"}},"required":["user_id","result"]}}'
```
They are not streaming. Model: redwood-1.3-large. They said errors started ~2026-02-20 14:00 UTC.

ben_ml: Likely schema drift / generation artefact — model injecting a trailing comma or small stray text. Quick mitigation options:
- Force deterministic sampling: temperature=0 and top_k=1 for these requests
- Wrap expected JSON with explicit delimiters and instruct system role to ONLY output raw JSON
- Post-validate and auto-repair with a tiny sanitizer (strip trailing commas or run json5 tolerant parser)

ben_ml: Example system + user prompt to reduce noise:
```
SYSTEM: You must ONLY emit a single JSON object that validates against the provided schema. No extra text, no markdown, no commentary.
USER: <customer payload>
```
Also add explicit marker tokens: "<<<JSON_START>>>" and "<<<JSON_END>>>" then strip everything before/after server-side.

ravi_se: Can we reproduce locally? What about recent deploys/param changes? If this is regresssion from model update we should escalate to eng-ml and add to the model rollout watchlist.

sam_oncall: FYI I see a config change in last deploy: sampling defaults bumped temp from 0.0 -> 0.7 for redwood-1.3-large (deploy 2026-02-20T13:50Z). That would increase non-determinism. I'll link the deploy:

deploy_bot: Deploy 2026-02-20T13:50Z by ci-pipeline — changed default sampling for heavy-traffic models. https://deploys.internal/12345 :rocket:

sam_oncall: Recommend 2-step mitigation:
1) Support: instruct Acme to set temperature=0 and mode=json with delimiters (quick client-side change)
2) Ops: rollback sampling change or pin their customer to a deterministic variant until we confirm model behavior

olivia_support: Drafting comms to Acme — Proposed message:
"Thanks for the report. We're treating this as high priority. Short-term mitigation: set temperature=0 and add explicit JSON delimiters as shown in our snippet. We will follow up within 4 hours with a platform-level mitigation. Apologies for the disruption. — Olivia"

ravi_se: I'll open an internal ticket and include repro + corp logs. Also capture the exact failing response from our proxy logs and time window.

ben_ml: For eng-ml: this looks like schema drift where the model occasionally outputs a trailing comma or plain-text note when it's uncertain. Can you escalate and include prompt + schema + failing outputs? We should consider a guard that post-validates model outputs and, if invalid, re-run with lower temperature or fallback model.

sam_oncall: Created INC-20260220-457 and assigned to eng-ml. Temporary policy: any requests with mode=json and customer SLA=true will be auto-routed to deterministic variant (temp=0) until further notice.

olivia_support: Acme is on an enterprise SLA. I'll send the mitigation note and offer a short maintenance window for us to apply the routing change. Also offering credits if they prefer.

ben_ml: For implementation details (copy for engineering):
- Add JSON output sanitizer middleware: attempt strict JSON parse; if parse fails, try json5 repair (remove trailing commas); if still fails, re-issue with temp=0 and log both responses.
- Add a metric: json_mode_parse_failures by model + customer; alert at >5/min

ravi_se: Repro steps I used locally:
1) curl request from above against staging with redwood-1.3-large at temp=0.7 -> sometimes returns trailing commas
2) repeat 20x, failure rate ~7/20
3) with temp=0 -> 0/20 failures

olivia_support: Thanks team. I'll send the customer note now and update ticket INC-20260220-457 with the suggested rollback + middleware path. Marking as priority P1.

sam_oncall: Noted. Monitoring dashboards for json_parse_failures created. Will ping here if we see spikes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

olivia_support: Closing loop when eng-ml has a plan. If anyone pushes a rollback, ping me so I can update Acme.

ben_ml: Assigning to myself to lead the short-term mitigation. Will open PR for middleware + metric tonight. :hammer_and_wrench:

olivia_support: Thanks all. Posting final customer update in 10m. :thumbsup:
